question: For a regular polygon, the sum of the interior angles is 100% more than the sum of its exterior angles. Each interior angle of the polygon measures x°. What is the value of x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of **exterior angles** of any regular polygon is always 360°.

Sum of **interior angles** = 100% more than 360° = 2 × 360° = 720°.

Using the formula (n − 2) × 180° = 720° ⇒ n − 2 = 4 ⇒ n = 6.

The polygon is a **regular hexagon**.

Each interior angle x = 720° ÷ 6 = 120°.

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sum of interior angles = Sum of exterior angles + 100% of Sum of exterior angles.

**Formula Used:** Sum of interior angles = (n − 2) × 180°; Sum of exterior angles = 360°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fbc9bff54918cad8642c649fe0a15015b8eccc9e7e17daae92054e50869fc98.png] 

⇒ Sum of exterior angles = 360°

⇒ Sum of interior angles = 360° + (100/100) × 360° = 720°

⇒ (n − 2) × 180° = 720°

⇒ n − 2 = 720 ÷ 180

⇒ n − 2 = 4

⇒ n = 6 (The polygon is a **regular hexagon**)

⇒ Each interior angle x = 720° ÷ 6 = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**
